title: The plus construction is separated and injects into its double plus
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Call a presheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $\mathcal C$ *separated* if for every covering $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ the map $\mathcal G(U)\to\prod_i\mathcal G(U_i)$, $s\mapsto(s|_{U_i})_i$, is injective (Stacks Sites, Definition 00WA). For a presheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ let $\mathcal G^+$, $\mathcal G^+(U)=\operatorname{colim}_{\mathcal J_U^{opp}}H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal G)$ (the colimit over the coverings of $U$ and their refinements of the zeroth Cech sets $H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal G)=\{(s_i)\in\prod_i\mathcal G(U_i)\mid s_i|_{U_i\times_UU_j}=s_j|_{U_i\times_UU_j}\}$), be its plus construction and $\theta_{\mathcal G}:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G^+$, $s\mapsto[\{\mathrm{id}_U\},s]$, the canonical map [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction]; $\mathcal G^+$ is a presheaf and $\theta_{\mathcal G}$ a morphism of presheaves [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf]. Let $\mathcal F$ be a presheaf of sets on $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal F^{++}=(\mathcal F^+)^+$. Then (1) $\mathcal F^+$ is separated: if $s,s'\in\mathcal F^+(U)$ and $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ is a covering with $s|_{U_i}=s'|_{U_i}$ for all $i$, then $s=s'$; and (2) the canonical map $\theta_{\mathcal F^+}:\mathcal F^+\to\mathcal F^{++}$ is injective, i.e. $\theta_{\mathcal F^+,U}:\mathcal F^+(U)\to\mathcal F^{++}(U)$ is injective for every object $U$.

source.place: Sites, Theorem 00WB (theorem-plus): part (1) and its proof; for (2), the first sentence of the proof of part (2) (for a separated presheaf $\mathcal G$ the map $\mathcal G\to\mathcal G^+$ is injective) applied to $\mathcal G=\mathcal F^+$, separated by part (1); definition of separated: Definition 00WA; plus construction: Section 00W1

proof.text: (Part (1).) Let $s,s'\in\mathcal F^+(U)$ and let $\mathcal U^0=\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ be a covering with $s|_{U_i}=s'|_{U_i}$ for all $i$. By [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf] (1) write $s=[\mathcal U,t]$ and $s'=[\mathcal U',t']$ with $t\in H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$, $t'\in H^0(\mathcal U',\mathcal F)$, $\mathcal U=\{U_a\to U\}_{a\in A}$, $\mathcal U'=\{U'_b\to U\}_{b\in B}$. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-site-coverings-common-refinement] twice, there is a covering $\mathcal W=\{W_j\to U\}_{j\in J}$ with morphisms of coverings over $\mathrm{id}_U$ to $\mathcal U^0$, $\mathcal U$ and $\mathcal U'$; so for every $j$ the map $w_j:W_j\to U$ factors as $W_j\to U_{i(j)}\to U$, as $W_j\xrightarrow{c_j}U_{a(j)}\to U$ and as $W_j\xrightarrow{c'_j}U'_{b(j)}\to U$. Put $x_j=t_{a(j)}|_{W_j}=\mathcal F(c_j)(t_{a(j)})$ and $x'_j=t'_{b(j)}|_{W_j}\in\mathcal F(W_j)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf] (3), $s|_{W_j}=\mathcal F^+(w_j)(s)=\theta_{W_j}(x_j)$ and $s'|_{W_j}=\theta_{W_j}(x'_j)$. Since $w_j$ factors through $U_{i(j)}\to U$ and $\mathcal F^+$ is a presheaf [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf] (4), $s|_{W_j}=(s|_{U_{i(j)}})|_{W_j}=(s'|_{U_{i(j)}})|_{W_j}=s'|_{W_j}$, hence $\theta_{W_j}(x_j)=\theta_{W_j}(x'_j)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf] (2) (the case of $\theta$) there is for each $j$ a covering $\{W_{jk}\to W_j\}_{k\in K_j}$ with $x_j|_{W_{jk}}=x'_j|_{W_{jk}}$ for all $k$. By axiom (ii) of a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $\mathcal V=\{W_{jk}\to W_j\to U\}_{(j,k)}$ is a covering of $U$. The maps $W_{jk}\to W_j\xrightarrow{c_j}U_{a(j)}$ with the index map $(j,k)\mapsto a(j)$ form a morphism of coverings $f:\mathcal V\to\mathcal U$ over $\mathrm{id}_U$, and likewise $f':\mathcal V\to\mathcal U'$ via $c'_j$ [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction] (b); by functoriality of $\mathcal F$, $(f^*t)_{(j,k)}=t_{a(j)}|_{W_{jk}}=x_j|_{W_{jk}}=x'_j|_{W_{jk}}=(f'^*t')_{(j,k)}$. Hence $f^*t=f'^*t'$, and by [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf] (2) $s=[\mathcal U,t]=[\mathcal U',t']=s'$. So $\mathcal F^+$ is separated.

source.place: Sites, Theorem 00WB, proof of (1) (with Lemma 00W6 for the common refinement and Lemma 00W9 for $s|_{W_j}=\theta(s_j)$)

proof.text: (A separated presheaf injects into its plus construction.) Let $\mathcal G$ be a separated presheaf of sets on $\mathcal C$ and $a,b\in\mathcal G(U)$ with $\theta_{\mathcal G,U}(a)=\theta_{\mathcal G,U}(b)$, i.e. $[\{\mathrm{id}_U\},a]=[\{\mathrm{id}_U\},b]$ [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction] (c). By [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf] (2) there is a covering $\{V_k\to U\}_{k\in K}$ with $a|_{V_k}=b|_{V_k}$ for all $k$, i.e. $a$ and $b$ have the same image in $\prod_k\mathcal G(V_k)$. Since $\mathcal G$ is separated (definition in the statement), $a=b$. Thus $\theta_{\mathcal G,U}$ is injective for every $U$.

source.place: Sites, Theorem 00WB, proof of (2), first sentence (the maps $\mathcal F(U)\to H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$ are injective for $\mathcal F$ separated), Definition 00WA

proof.text: (Part (2).) $\mathcal F^+$ is a presheaf of sets [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf] (4), separated by the first step; the second step applied to $\mathcal G=\mathcal F^+$ shows that $\theta_{\mathcal F^+}:\mathcal F^+\to(\mathcal F^+)^+=\mathcal F^{++}$ is injective on every object.

Proof in three steps following the proof of 00WB(1) and the first sentence of 00WB(2): separatedness of F^+ via a common refinement (new lem-weil-pbc-site-coverings-common-refinement, 00W6) and the description of F^+ (new lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf: 00W4, 00W7/00W8 description, 00W9); a separated presheaf injects into its plus; apply to F^+. lean.statement: theorem plus_separated_and_injective {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : Precoverage C) [J.HasIsos] [J.IsStableUnderComposition] [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks] (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max u w)) : (∀ (U : C) (E : Precoverage.ZeroHypercover.{max u w} J U) (s s' : (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P).obj (op U)), (∀ i : E.toPreZeroHypercover.I₀, (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P).map (E.toPreZeroHypercover.f i).op s = (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P).map (E.toPreZeroHypercover.f i).op s') → s = s') ∧ (∀ (U : C), Function.Injective ((J.toGrothendieck.toPlus (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P)).app (op U)))
lean.note: Uses the recorded small Precoverage site and generated-topology plus construction. The first conjunct tests separatedness on indexed covering families; the second is objectwise injectivity of toPlus applied to plusObj P, from P-plus to P-double-plus. SmallCategory provides the required Type-valued limits and colimits without additional hypotheses.
